_doc: Revert-verify mutants for issue #4357 — a created concept must land BESIDE its parent (inside an assetspace), not in a hardcoded top-level `concepts/` folder which is outside every assetspace and therefore never carried by ExoSync. Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute). M1 restores the pre-fix state verbatim. `red_re` anchors on the `● <suite> › <title>` failure header, not the bare `[Cn]` key (integration-test-revert-verify §A44/§A104).
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/services/ConceptCreationService.ts

M1_hardcoded_top_level_folder._note: The pre-fix state verbatim: the destination becomes the literal the bug shipped. ⛔ Note the OLD test could not catch this — it asserted `stringContaining("concepts/")`, which the CORRECT path `assetspaces/.../exoas-concept/concept/x.md` also satisfies. The axes now compare the full path, which is what makes this mutant detectable at all.

M2_anchor_not_inherited._note: Keeps the placement fix but drops the anchor inheritance, so the child declares the fail-open `[[!concepts]]` while sitting in a real assetspace. That combination is precisely what makes the placement UNCHECKABLE by `audit co-location` — the bang anchor is fail-open by design — so this mutant guards the half of the fix that restores auditability.

M3_no_fallback_when_parent_has_no_anchor._note: Removes the compatibility fallback: a parent without an anchor would yield an EMPTY isDefinedBy rather than the previous `[[!concepts]]`. Guards that the fix is additive for parents that predate anchoring, rather than silently emitting a broken value.
